verdict.rationale: Qodo exposes part of its functionality programmatically. The official MCP server and CLI let agents review changes, retrieve and resolve findings, and fetch rules and standards. Configuration can also be managed as code via .pr_agent.toml. However, no general public API is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Many portal capabilities show no programmatic equivalent, including portal configuration, governance history and dashboards, Software Map, Rule Miner, and Agentic Toolbox access management. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/OpenAPI API, an explicit API-to-UI parity claim, programmatic access to governance/analytics, portal settings and admin/access management, and independent corroboration.
